source: Every item here is something she has actually posted making. She has NEVER published a price for the infusion add-on - her own words are 'I can infuse your food for an additional price' (post SF-37, 2021-06-22). So every price is 'Ask'. Do not invent one. The 'Shroom' items on her deleted 2021 dessert menu are deliberately NOT here - see research/menu-extracted.md section 4.

sections.title: The Add-On
sections.heading: It is an add-on, not a separate kitchen
sections.note: She makes her own infused butter and cooks with it. That means most things on The Kitchen menu can be made infused. She sets the price per dish and per strength, so every item here says Ask - text her and she will quote you.

items.name: Any Dish, Infused
items.desc: Pick anything off The Kitchen menu and ask her to infuse it. She quotes the add-on based on the dish and the strength you want.

items.name: Infused Butter
items.desc: The base she cooks with. She makes it herself.
